progression.narrative: The performance opens on F3 and dwells most on C in Owj. Razavi (0:26.6) introduces G, Ak, Bb, centred on C. The line peaks at F4 (363.1 Hz) at 0:16.6. It closes on Ak3, not the tonic (C3 → C4 → G3 → C4 → G3 → Ak3).
